findings: 380-fold comparison is recovered recombinant/mutant CFU abundance, not an independently observed molecular event ratio.
Chromosomal reporter origin classification is distinguished from sequencing every scored colony.
Kanamycin and spectinomycin select only after sampling; chloramphenicol maintenance remains present during growth.
Repeated time points do not multiply triplicate independent culture counts; pairing and inference not replayed.
Gene interventions support assay-specific transfer, while growth differences, detection limits, and unauthenticated supplementary controls remain explicit.
Flat terminal census is not proof of zero turnover, births, death or selective clone histories.
The sum of mutation and transfer intensities is established conditional bookkeeping, not a new theorem or empirical SBW25 parameter.
Imported allele identity cannot be relabelled de novo mutation; ecological controls needed before mutation-only interpretation.
